server.description: HTTP server configuration: interface, port, concurrency, and TLS toggle.

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the HTTP server to.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections the server will accept.

ssl.description: SSL/TLS certificate and key file paths — required only if HTTPS is enabled.

certfile.description: Absolute path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format).

keyfile.description: Absolute path to the SSL private key file (PEM format).

database.description: Database backend settings. Supports SQLite (file-based) or PostgreSQL.

type.description: Database type. Use 'sqlite' for single-instance deployments, 'postgresql' for production clusters.

path.description: Absolute path to the SQLite database file (ignored if type=postgresql).

cache.description: Caching configuration for computed structures. Use 'memory' for single-node or 'redis' for distributed caching.

enabled.description: Enable result caching to reduce computation load.

type.description: Cache backend type. 'redis' recommended for multi-instance deployments.

redis_url.description: Redis server URL (used only if type='redis').

max_size.description: Maximum number of entries in the in-memory cache (used only if type='memory').

workers.description: Parallel worker configuration for heavy structure processing tasks.

count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn. Set to 1 for development; 4–16 for production depending on CPU cores.

request_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) a worker may spend processing a single request before timeout.

file.description: Absolute path to the log file. Set to '-' to log to stdout.

pubchem_enabled.description: Allow fallback lookups to PubChem (NCBI) when local data is missing.

service_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for external service requests (e.g., PubChem).

cors.origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing). Each entry defines a permitted client origin.

port.description: Optional port to restrict origin to (e.g., 3000 for localhost dev).
